questions.question: Which network device is responsible for connecting different networks, such as an internal local area network (LAN) and an external network, while determining the optimal path for data transmission?

answerOptions.text: Router
answerOptions.rationale: Routers operate between distinct networks to direct data packets toward their destination across internal and external network boundaries.

answerOptions.text: Hub and Switch
answerOptions.rationale: Hubs and switches manage communication between multiple devices within the same local area network rather than routing between separate networks.

answerOptions.text: Wireless Access Point (AP)
answerOptions.rationale: Wireless APs connect wired and wireless network segments using Wi-Fi rather than routing data across different network boundaries.

answerOptions.text: Firewall
answerOptions.rationale: Firewalls serve as security barriers to block unauthorized access rather than managing routing paths between different networks.

questions.hint: Consider the device that acts as a bridge between separate networks to guide data along its destination path.

questions.question: What is a primary advantage of using Ethernet cables over optical cables when setting up a wired local area network (LAN)?

answerOptions.text: Lower deployment costs and higher physical flexibility
answerOptions.rationale: Ethernet cables offer an affordable and flexible cabling solution, making them ideal for standard LAN installations.

answerOptions.text: Higher data transmission speeds over extremely long distances
answerOptions.rationale: Long-distance high-speed transmission is the primary strength of optical cables rather than Ethernet cables.

answerOptions.text: Complete elimination of location constraints during device usage
answerOptions.rationale: All wired connections impose physical location constraints because devices must remain tethered by cables.

answerOptions.text: Direct transmission of radio frequencies through open air
answerOptions.rationale: Transmitting signals through open air using radio frequencies is a defining characteristic of wireless networks.

questions.hint: Think about why Ethernet cables are widely chosen for budget-conscious and adaptable indoor network wiring.

questions.question: Which feature distinguishes Near Field Communication (NFC) from standard RFID technology?

answerOptions.text: It operates without physical contact at a very close distance within 10 cm
answerOptions.rationale: NFC is a specialized form of RFID designed specifically for non-contact data exchange at extremely short ranges under 10 cm.

answerOptions.text: It requires a complex device pairing process before data transfer
answerOptions.rationale: Pairing is a connection procedure characteristic of Bluetooth technology rather than NFC.

answerOptions.text: It allows data transmission across distances of up to 10 meters
answerOptions.rationale: A 10-meter operating range is typical for Bluetooth communication, whereas NFC is restricted to under 10 cm.

answerOptions.text: It converts wired LAN signals directly into Wi-Fi signals
answerOptions.rationale: Converting wired network signals into Wi-Fi is the role of a Wireless Access Point.

questions.hint: Focus on the specific maximum operating distance required for contactless mobile payment systems.

questions.question: Which wireless technology functions within a 10-meter range, uses a connection procedure known as 'pairing,' and is commonly used for wireless earphones and smart speakers?

answerOptions.text: Bluetooth
answerOptions.rationale: Bluetooth connects short-range peripheral devices within 10 meters using a pairing process to establish a link.

answerOptions.text: Wi-Fi
answerOptions.rationale: Wi-Fi is primarily used to connect devices to a wireless local area network for high-speed internet access.

answerOptions.text: RFID
answerOptions.rationale: RFID uses radio waves to read information stored on embedded semiconductor tags or cards rather than pairing audio devices.

answerOptions.text: Miracast
answerOptions.rationale: Miracast is a display sharing protocol used for screen mirroring rather than connecting audio peripherals.

questions.hint: Think about the protocol activated when syncing wireless earbuds to a mobile phone.

questions.question: What is the primary security function of a firewall in a network environment?

answerOptions.text: To block unauthorized external access and malicious cyber attacks
answerOptions.rationale: Firewalls safeguard network integrity by preventing illegal access and malicious intrusions from outside networks.

answerOptions.text: To assign physical IP addresses to all computing devices on a LAN
answerOptions.rationale: Assigning network addresses and routing traffic are networking functions handled by routers and switches.

answerOptions.text: To duplicate screen displays across multiple student terminals
answerOptions.rationale: Duplicating or sharing screen content across terminals relies on display sharing technologies.

answerOptions.text: To enable non-contact traffic payment processing via mobile devices
answerOptions.rationale: Mobile traffic payments are facilitated by NFC or RFID technology rather than network firewalls.

questions.hint: Focus on the mechanism designed to protect an internal network from external threats.

questions.question: In display sharing technologies like Miracast and DLNA, what is the term for sending an exact copy of one device's screen to another display in real time?

answerOptions.text: Mirroring
answerOptions.rationale: Mirroring accurately replicates the display content of one information device onto another screen in real time.

answerOptions.text: Pairing
answerOptions.rationale: Pairing refers to the initial handshake and connection setup between two Bluetooth devices.

answerOptions.text: Routing
answerOptions.rationale: Routing is the process of selecting paths along which to send network data packets.

answerOptions.text: Authentication
answerOptions.rationale: Authentication involves verifying personal identity, such as through biometric fingerprint scanning.

questions.hint: Consider the word that describes creating a direct visual reflection of a display.

questions.question: Which statement accurately describes a major characteristic of wired networks compared to wireless networks?

answerOptions.text: They offer fast and stable data transmission despite location constraints
answerOptions.rationale: Physical cable connections limit device mobility but deliver highly reliable and high-speed data transfers.

answerOptions.text: They eliminate the physical equipment needed to build a LAN
answerOptions.rationale: Wired networks require physical infrastructure such as Ethernet cables, optical cables, and switches.

answerOptions.text: They allow devices to move freely without physical space restrictions
answerOptions.rationale: Freedom of movement without location constraints is the main advantage of wireless networks.

answerOptions.text: They utilize radio frequency bands to transmit data through open air
answerOptions.rationale: Radio frequency transmission through air is the core mechanism of wireless communication.

questions.hint: Weigh the trade-off between physical cable tethering and data reliability.

questions.question: What role does a Wireless Access Point (AP) perform in a local network infrastructure?

answerOptions.text: It connects a wired LAN with a wireless LAN using Wi-Fi technology
answerOptions.rationale: A Wireless AP acts as a bridge, allowing wireless client devices to access the wired local network via Wi-Fi.

answerOptions.text: It reads semiconductor chip data embedded in product labels
answerOptions.rationale: Scanning semiconductor tags on products is performed by RFID readers.

answerOptions.text: It tracks real-time vehicle positions using communication satellites
answerOptions.rationale: Vehicle position tracking relies on location information systems utilizing satellites.

answerOptions.text: It physically connects local computers using Ethernet cables
answerOptions.rationale: Physical cable connections between multiple computers are handled by hubs and switches.

questions.hint: Identify the equipment that converts a wired local network into an accessible Wi-Fi zone.

questions.question: According to the textbook material, what is a key advantage of Wi-Fi over mobile cellular internet?

answerOptions.text: Lower usage cost and faster transmission speed
answerOptions.rationale: Wi-Fi generally provides higher data transfer speeds at a lower cost compared to cellular mobile internet.

answerOptions.text: Unlimited coverage area with zero spatial distance constraints
answerOptions.rationale: Wi-Fi coverage is limited to a relatively small area surrounding the wireless access point.

answerOptions.text: Seamless data connection while traveling across long distances without local hubs
answerOptions.rationale: Mobile internet is better suited for continuous connection while traveling over long distances.

answerOptions.text: Automatic identity verification through fingerprint recognition
answerOptions.rationale: Fingerprint verification is a feature of biometric authentication systems, not Wi-Fi networks.

questions.hint: Consider why people often switch from mobile data to Wi-Fi when indoors.

questions.question: What is the defining feature of the Internet of Things (IoT) system?

answerOptions.text: Everyday physical objects are connected to the internet to exchange data and enable remote control
answerOptions.rationale: IoT links various everyday items to the internet so they can send and receive data for functions like remote management.

answerOptions.text: Devices communicate strictly over 10 cm non-contact distances for payment processing
answerOptions.rationale: Short-range non-contact payment processing within 10 cm is characteristic of NFC.

answerOptions.text: Display screens are linked exclusively between teacher and student computers in a classroom
answerOptions.rationale: Connecting classroom monitors is an application of display sharing technology.

answerOptions.text: User identity is confirmed using individual biometric physical characteristics
answerOptions.rationale: Identity confirmation using physical characteristics describes biometric authentication systems.

questions.hint: Focus on how physical household objects gain internet connectivity and remote control capabilities.
